prompt:
Create a high-fidelity mobile landing page for the fictional Minsk coffee roastery «Кварта», edge to edge on a 9:16 portrait canvas, showing a usable opening and the start of the catalog. Render crisp readable Russian text, without a browser window, phone frame or surrounding desk.

The webpage is a neighborhood workshop noticeboard. Deep bottle-green painted ground carries ONE oversized off-white uncoated workshop notice. This single notice organizes the whole opening: expressive sturdy Cyrillic sans lettering, restrained melon print, quiet ordinary text. Keep one coherent vertical composition with aligned content. The main notice’s name and Thursday-to-Friday schedule establish the dominant focal move; its lower portion is the directly usable callback slip. A small tangible coffee pack belongs inside the notice’s offer area, like an integrated product specimen. It must never create a second hero column. No parallel cards, icon benefits, scattered notes or adjacent photo panel.

The visitor buys fresh beans for home or office through a manager callback. Use «Кварта», «Ваш кофе. Соседняя обжарка.», «В четверг обжариваем — в пятницу привозим», «Кофе от 26 BYN», «Подписка · 54 BYN / месяц». Small batches are 5 kg. Above the notice, navigation reads plainly as links: «Кофе», «Подписка», «Доставка».

The notice’s single-column form has visible labels above generously sized empty controls: «Имя», «Телефон». Then ONE mutually exclusive interest group: «Разовый заказ», «Подписка», «Вопрос». Include one optional «Комментарий» field, «Перезвоним и поможем с выбором» and a prominent «Оставить заявку» button. Keep all form text and controls readable at mobile size.

Below the notice, begin a quiet plain list headed «Что обжариваем»: «Эфиопия Иргачеффе · 250 г · 32 BYN», «Цветы, бергамот». No invented contact details, extra tasting claims or business claims. The notice is the working webpage, never a decorative poster.
